description: This file defines a Lexer class for tokenizing JMESPath expressions, including token types, states, and the logic for parsing input strings into tokens.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: A class responsible for tokenizing JMESPath expressions into a sequence of tokens.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes a JMESPath input string into an array of tokens.

methods.name: matchOr
methods.description: Returns a token based on whether the next character matches the expected value.

methods.name: inside
methods.description: Consumes characters inside delimiters, handling escape sequences, and returns the token.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON literal token, handling errors and adding quotes if necessary.
